description: This file contains Python classes for testing storage devices (USB and MMC) in a runtime environment, including mounting, unmounting, and basic file operations.

classes.name: StorageBase
classes.description: Base class providing storage mounting, unmounting, and file operation methods.

classes.name: UsbTest
classes.description: Derived class for testing USB storage device operations.

classes.name: MMCTest
classes.description: Derived class for testing MMC storage device operations.

methods.name: storage_mount
methods.description: Mounts the storage device and verifies it is mounted.

methods.name: storage_basic
methods.description: Performs basic file creation, move, and delete operations on the storage device.

methods.name: storage_read
methods.description: Reads a test message from a file on the storage device and verifies its content.

methods.name: storage_write
methods.description: Writes a test message to a file on the storage device.

methods.name: storage_umount
methods.description: Unmounts the storage device and verifies it is unmounted.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes test parameters for USB and MMC tests.

methods.name: test_usb_basic_operations
methods.description: Tests basic file operations on the USB device.

methods.name: test_usb_basic_rw
methods.description: Tests read/write operations on the USB device.

methods.name: test_mmc_basic_operations
methods.description: Tests basic file operations on the MMC device.

methods.name: test_mmc_basic_rw
methods.description: Tests read/write operations on the MMC device.
